# Android architecture — Browse / Discover / For You / recs / search / Artists / History / Recognizer

Baseline measured in the worktree: Android unit tests = **275 `@Test`** (every package below must move that number, not just stay green). Android already has the right spine for this area: lenient `PdjJson`, offline-first `CatalogRepository`/`MergedCatalog`, `PlayHistoryStore` + `CollectionActivityStore` (iOS-shaped docs), `PlayEventBus` fired from `PlaybackService.onMediaItemTransition`, `CollectionsStore.playNow` + `historyContext`, `RemoteEndpoints` with `REC_ENGINE_BASE` / `LISTENING_POCKETS_BASE` / `SEARCH_CONFIG_URL`, and the vendored MusicKit AARs + `MusicKitDeveloperTokenClient`. Nothing here needs Room, Hilt, or WorkManager; the iOS stores are durable JSON + atomic rename, and Android already copies that idiom.

## 1. Package layout (new vs modified)

## 2. Data flow and threading

Doctrine (ported from iOS, already in force on Android): **every engine is a pure function over value snapshots, run on `Dispatchers.Default`; stores are single-writer, `synchronized(lock)` + `StateFlow`; views read `StateFlow`s and never compute in a composable body.**

- **Browse pipeline**: `BrowseRows.of(catalog)` (memo by catalog identity) → `BrowseEngine.filterSort(base, searchKeys, query, clauses, sortKeys, playCounts)` in `produceState`+`withContext(Default)` keyed on `(catalog, kind, debouncedQuery, clauses, sortKeys, playCountsRevision if usesPlayCounts)` → read-time layer `applyReadTimeFilters(items, membership, favorites)` applied synchronously over the already-sorted list (cheap O(n) Set lookups, never memoized) → paging prefix keyed by result version. Memo key = JSON of the clause VALUES (never clause UUIDs), sorted keys, exactly as `BrowseState.resultsKey`.
- **History**: `buildItems()` on the store's events (hide-skips applied at BASE build, so it is part of the base key) → the same `BrowseEngine.filterSort` with `lastPlayedAt` taken from the row's `PlayRef`. Port the three `refreshExternal` guards verbatim: (1) debounce BEFORE building the base, (2) abandon the publish if the filter/sort signature moved during the await, (3) never memoize an empty base and never stamp a display key when no base is bound. `pagingKey` deliberately excludes catalog identity.
- **Recs**: `ForYouTilesScreen` snapshots inputs on Main (catalog → `ZoneCatalog.tracks`, `history.recentPlaysForZone()`, counts, crates, feedback projections with skip penalties, `recsOff` ids, `TimbreCatalog.vectors()` awaited first) → `ForYouFeedStore.refresh` runs `ForYouFeedBuilder.build` on `Default` → commits snapshot → optional `cloudZone()` second commit via `applyingCloudZone`. The grid derives cards with `ForYouGrid.tiles(snapshot, collections, feedback, releaseFeed)` keyed on `feed.revision | feedback.revision | releaseFeed.revision | collection counts | membershipRevision | recsOff ids`. Only three things recompute the ranking: menu Refresh, first build after `catalog != null`, schedule due (checked on tab open and `ON_RESUME` via `ProcessLifecycleOwner`; never a timer or WorkManager).
- **Cloud**: `RecommendationService.flushNow()` is a coroutine on `appScope`; `flushEpoch` invalidation after every `await`; `startAutoFlush` = debounced 60 s loop while enabled. Requests use the existing `AppGraph.httpClient` (OkHttp, 20 s / 30 s timeouts).
- **Discover**: `DiscoverSearchModel.searchDebounced(400 ms)` runs Apple Music REST search (dev token) and rip-server `GET /search` in parallel (`async` pair), merges and dedupes by store id (REST leads, server song rows win ties on ripped/url), refines by artist client-side.
- **Shazam**: `ShazamRecognizer` wraps `com.shazam.shazamkit` `StreamingSession` fed by an `AudioRecord` (48 kHz mono PCM16) on an IO coroutine; results → `ShazamCatalogMatch.resolve` (pure) → `StateFlow<ShazamPhase>`.

## 3. Platform APIs

| Need | API |
|---|---|
| Online search creds | DataStore blob encrypted with an Android Keystore AES-GCM key (`SecretBox` helper; `androidx.security:security-crypto` is deprecated) |
| SigV4 | `javax.crypto.Mac` HmacSHA256 + `MessageDigest` SHA-256; no AWS SDK |
| Apple Music REST (search, artists latest-release, library add) | OkHttp + `Authorization: Bearer <devToken>` (+ `Music-User-Token` from `AppSettings.musicUserToken` for /v1/me/*) |
| Unowned-release / `am:<storeId>` playback | existing `AppleMusicBackend` (DRM, device-only) |
| Shazam | vendored ShazamKit for Android AAR (`app/libs/shazamkit-android-*.aar`, same flatDir pattern as MusicKit) + `RECORD_AUDIO` runtime permission; `Activity.shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale` drives the `.denied` → open-settings phase |
| Share | `Intent.ACTION_SEND` with `ShareText.forSong/forAlbum/forSongs` |
| Lyrics cache | `filesDir/lyrics-cache/<safe id>.txt` |
| Schedule read points | `ProcessLifecycleOwner` `ON_RESUME` + tab enter |
| Dates | `DateRangePicker` already used by History; reuse for `lastPlayedAt`/`dateAdded` between editors (epoch ms, end-of-day = next-day-start − 1 ms via `java.time` zone rules) |
| Background drain for release feed | none; lazy on-play, in-process coroutine with 2 s debounce (iOS parity) |

## 4. Persistence formats (shape-compatible with iOS for the future S3 sync)

All files in `filesDir`, atomic tmp+rename, lenient decode, additive-optional fields, `installId` carried:
- `pocketdj-play-history.json` — extend `PlayEvent` with the six optional fields; `originInstallId` stamped = `installId` on record; `wasSkipped`/`listenedFraction` MAX-merged.
- `pocketdj-collection-activity.json` — add `catalogAdd` / `catalogRemove` kinds + `libraryWrite`, `itemArtist` optional.
- `pocketdj-foryou-feed.json` — exactly `ForYouFeedSnapshot` (`schemaVersion` 3; `zoneSourceRaw` string; `reasons`/`soundIds` nullable). Match the iOS file name (read `ForYouFeedStore.defaultURL()`).
- `pocketdj-rec-feedback.json` — `{schemaVersion, installId, decisions[], playing?, seq}`; `verdict`/`surface` as strings; per-row lenient decode (a corrupt row never drops the log).
- `pocketdj-rec-key.json` (`{schemaVersion:1,key}`), `pocketdj-rec-sync.json` (`SyncState` cursors/acks/audio lists), `pocketdj-rec-pending-delete.json`.
- `pocketdj-release-feed.json` (`{schemaVersion, entries[], seededAtMs?}`), `pocketdj-discover-adds.json` (`{schemaVersion:1, entries[], albums?}`), `pocketdj-timeline-cues.json`.
- Browse snapshot (DataStore key `browseSnapshotJson`): add `clauses: [{id,field,op,value,values[],min?,max?}]`; keep decoding the legacy `genres/bpmMin/bpmMax/camelots/sources` into clauses when `clauses` is absent (one-way, drop legacy on next write). History gets its own key `historySnapshotJson`.

## 5. Invariants a port must preserve (hard-won)

1. Off-main filter/sort with a value-based memo key; paging prefix derived from the result signature in the same frame.
2. Read-time layers (membership, favorites) are NEVER in the memo key and NEVER persisted.
3. `activeFilterCount` counts favorite-only and hide-skips so the toolbar glyph stays honest; Clear All owns favorite + hide-skips, NOT membership.
4. History: event-id row identity; 30 s window LOCAL to this install; hide-skips in the base key; `pagingKey` excludes catalog revision; never memoize an empty base; signature re-check after every await.
5. Skip = advanced-away with position/duration < 0.5 (strict); natural end / repeat / stop / pause never classify; one-deep previous stash; high-water mark; restart re-zeroes.
6. For You is frozen; feedback and membership edits re-derive CARDS, never the ranking; empty-catalog refresh is gated; schedule is evaluated at read.
7. Zone: ≥ 50 % rediscovery floor, ≤ 3 per artist, thumbed-down removed from the queue but SUNK (rendered, dim) on screens; accepted rows removed permanently in zone/new; a collection switched off gets no sweep AND loses its tile next frame.
8. Online search resets paging on sort change; `{id:asc}` tiebreak last; advance `loadedCount` by RAW hit count; drop a stale page when `from != loadedCount`.
9. Edition policy: collection clean-only beats the global toggle; clean-only skips, never falls back; substitution only when the edition id is known and ≠ primary; never enqueue a rip for an un-named edition.
10. Discover: provisional rows appended AFTER real sources (first-wins merge shadows without deleting); album add records ACCEPTED tracks only; one batched inject; supersede by `appleMusicId` remaps collection references.
11. Release feed: ≤ 50 ids per request, concurrency 2, only 429/5xx retryable, drain is global (`isFetching` guard), re-arm only after a clean pass, status classified at read.

## 6. Mix DSP engine
Not touched by this area; no decision taken here.
decisions: Remove the Android-only 'Unified' History tab to match iOS (removed 2026-08-10): tabs = Playback | Collection | Pockets (gated) | For You (gated), every tab visible, current filled; Rewind-to-here lives on Playback rows.

Replace the typed P1 `BrowseFilters` with the full iOS clause registry (18 fields, 5 ops) behind ONE pure `BrowseEngine.filterSort`; Browse, History, collection details and the future queue builder all consume it. Legacy snapshot fields are decoded forward once.

Online search goes DIRECT to the aoss host with a pure-Kotlin SigV4 signer (no AWS SDK, no CloudFront proxy — the proxy is a PWA CORS workaround only); creds live in a Keystore-encrypted DataStore blob.

Discover's full-catalog search uses the Apple Music REST API with the developer token Android already mints (no MusicKit SDK needed for search), in parallel with the rip-server `/search` iTunes proxy for subscription-free coverage; adds require the Music-User-Token.

Shazam recognition uses Apple's vendored ShazamKit-for-Android AAR (same flatDir pattern as the MusicKit AARs) fed by AudioRecord; recognition is device-only, the matcher and action reducer are pure and unit-tested.

The on-device recommendation engine (ZoneEngine + SimilarityFamilies + identity/shaping) is ported as pure Kotlin with tuning constants verbatim and parity fixtures; the cloud engine stays opt-in/off by default; the rec key is device-local JSON (no CloudKit) and profileId = installId.
'Plays' on Android = local PlayHistoryStore counts only; the Apple play-count baseline (PlayCountService/AMPlayBaselineStore) is N/A on Android.

New releases ride the Apple Music REST artists endpoint with dev + user token; playing an unowned release routes `am:<storeId>` through AppleMusicBackend (DRM, device-only). Requires `IndexJson.artists` decoding.
For You refresh schedule is evaluated at read (tab open + ON_RESUME), never WorkManager/AlarmManager, matching the owner's 'cache, refresh on demand' rule.
Persisted documents keep the iOS file names and field names so the future S3 profile sync can union them (installId + per-event ids everywhere).
Mix DSP engine decision is out of scope for this area; nothing here depends on it.
